name: data2explore
description: Local-first desktop app for high-frequency checks on survey data
author: Thoriq Akbar

scripts.engine:profile: cd engine && uv run python -m d2e_engine profile --input ../samples/sample_survey.csv --out ../samples/profile_output.json
scripts.engine:summarize: cd engine && uv run python -m d2e_engine summarize --input ../samples/sample_survey.csv --mapping ../samples/sample_mapping.json --out ../samples/summary_output.json
scripts.engine:freeze: cd engine && uv run pyinstaller d2e_engine.spec --noconfirm
scripts.package: corepack pnpm engine:freeze && corepack pnpm build && corepack pnpm dist
